release_notes: The till no longer stops responding while a sale screen is opening. Cash change is counted once. Split payments show under M-Pesa, card, and bank. A debt repayment keeps today's date. Settings saved on the till and the live dashboard use one versioned save and keep a change history. Finance currency and tax remain the values used on receipts. Category tile size and image fit are stored in the same file the till reads. A dashboard test-page request stays waiting until the till queues it. The owner portal keeps a sign-in when several requests refresh together and shows the real debt amount.
